Pranav Saxena | pranav.saxena928@example.com | +91 9634951016
Bangalore

Professional Summary
Talent-focused HR professional with a track record of sourcing, assessing, and onboarding high-quality candidates across technical and corporate functions. Proven ability to manage full-cycle recruitment processes, stakeholder coordination, and applicant tracking using modern tools to reduce time-to-hire and improve hire quality. Notice period: 30 days.

Technical Skills
Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, LinkedIn Recruiter, Workday, Jira, Confluence

Work Experience

Talent Acquisition Specialist, Dream11 (Mar 2025 - Present)
- Managed end-to-end Recruitment for product and engineering roles using LinkedIn Recruiter to build targeted talent pipelines and reduce time-to-screen by 30%; coordinated interviews via Workday.
- Partnered with hiring managers to define role requirements, created structured interview plans, and tracked progress in Jira to ensure SLAs were met.
- Implemented candidate experience improvements documented in Confluence, resulting in higher offer acceptance rates and streamlined onboarding handoffs in Workday.

HR Executive, Bluefin Logistics (Apr 2022 - Feb 2025)
- Executed full-cycle Talent Acquisition for operations and corporate functions, leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter and internal job boards to increase pipeline quality and shorten vacancy duration.
- Coordinated recruitment logistics and candidate communications in Workday, maintained hiring trackers in Jira, and recorded process updates in Confluence to improve recruiter-hiring manager alignment.
- Conducted screening and interview scheduling, facilitated offer negotiations, and supported onboarding activities to ensure smooth new-hire integration.

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
